notes: governed feeds check 7 (change detection) for every entry; checks 1 and 3 declare narrower input sets of their own.
project_organization.json and scripts/wiki_*.py are governed so that changing the rules themselves requires a version bump.
spec_lifecycle_glob is check 1's input set. 01_Specs/TEMPLATE.md is excluded from it by construction: it lives directly under 01_Specs/, not in a lifecycle folder.
03_Format_Spec/** is governed but outside check 1 - its docs carry '**Status:** Shipping', a version-state word on a different axis from the spec lifecycle.
